{{Quote|During certain maneuvers, the jets produce a turbulent backwash of superheated air which creates an immensely loud, high-pitched shrieking sound.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="Databank" />}}
'''Rebu''' was an individual who lived during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In addition to bearing the [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|title]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], Rebu also served as an [[Inspector-General]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Rebu represented the interests of the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] by overseeing the successful field testing of the [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis''-class gunship]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Both the Hellcaster cannon and concussion missiles were highly effective in, respectively, an anti-personnel and anti-armor capacity, and the gunship returned to base with only minimal damage.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="Databank" />}}
Rebu was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUII">Since Rebu lived during the time of the Galactic Empire ([[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in 19 BBY), and since the events of ''The Force Unleashed II'' occur in 1 BBY, prior to the [[Rebellion era]], Rebu's lifetime is based in the Rise of the Empire era.</ref> in the Moff's capacity as an [[Inspector-General]], Rebu was responsible for overseeing the development and field testing of the newly created [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis''-class gunship]].<ref name="Databank" />

Rebu oversaw the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] model's first [[Battle of Polomie|deployment]] to [[Polomie]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that contained a [[Alliance Military/Legends|Rebel military]] outpost. The gunship exceeded all expectations when it obliterated the Rebel presence on Polomie. Following the success of the craft's first field test, Rebu provided a detailed report to the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]], and was pleased to inform the department that the new gunship was an excellent addition to the vast quantity of [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] at the Empire's disposal. However, Rebu was disappointed by the fact that the gunship's heavy arsenal was far too expensive for mass production. Consequently, Rebu anticipated that the small number of ''Nemesis''-class gunships would only be affordable to the exceptionally wealthy Moffs and [[Governor/Legends|governors]] of the Empire.<ref name="Databank" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|However, while the ''Nemesis'' is an extremely effective weapons-platform, perfectly suited to the roles of close-air support and civilian pacification, it may simply be too exotic for widespread service.|Inspector-General Moff Rebu|<ref name="Databank" />}}
Moff Rebu was an Inspector-General who supported the Galactic Empire in its war against the Rebel Alliance. While surveying the ''Nemesis''-class gunship, of which Rebu paid close attention to every detail and aspect, the Moff was greatly pleased with the new vessel and its capability of annihilating Rebel forces while sustaining only minimal damage. Rebu was also proud of the gunship's highly effective yet costly firepower and weapons arsenal. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], Rebu was displeased by the fact that the craft was far too expensive to be built in larger numbers.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Inspector-General Moff Rebu was first referenced in the databank of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''. Rebu's report to the Imperial Department of Military Research can be found in the "Nemesis Gunship" profile.<ref name="Databank" />
